abi.source: Installed ESP-IDF headers and C6 Server ELF disassembly of r_os_msys_get_pkthdr, r__os_msys_find_pool and r_ble_ll_mem_msys_init. The latter ORs bit 1 into mp_flags; the former selects that pool for packet headers.

conditions: Single sequential native C6 example runs; macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Rust 1.96.0, default JIT, 160 MHz cycle clock. Host load uncontrolled; a separate reboot validation overlapped the beginning of the example batch. Wall time includes launch and image/ELF loading. No timing calibration or speed comparison.
privacy: Only task source, commands, synthetic BLE addresses, artifact hashes and selected results retained. Home labels normalized before retaining diagnostic captures; original and normalized hashes recorded below. No private originals committed.

negative_attempts.name: default flash capacity
negative_attempts.error: Detected size(4096k) smaller than the size in the binary image header(8192k). Probe failed.
negative_attempts.resolution: Pass --flash-mb 8; unchanged board firmware has an 8 MiB flash header.

negative_attempts.name: runtime trampoline through loader
negative_attempts.resolution: C6 load_bytes intentionally ignores flash-window loads. Install only the checked contiguous physical flash span, preserving original bytes for reset. The loader is unchanged.

negative_attempts.name: ACL pool selection
negative_attempts.resolution: The ESP-IDF packet-header allocator requires mp_flags bit 1; set that bit after real guest mempool initialization. Discovery then passes.

negative_attempts.name: Write capture
negative_attempts.error: The combined stdout/stderr capture split New value: Hello from host with the write-complete diagnostic.
negative_attempts.resolution: Capture serial separately from diagnostic stderr. The byte-exact serial callback and readback checks pass.

negative_attempts.name: assembler comment
negative_attempts.error: junk at end of line, first unrecognized character is '/'
negative_attempts.resolution: Use assembler # comment syntax. Assembly succeeds; extracted bytes exactly match the Rust trampoline.

cleanup.scope: Only /tmp/up-ble-firmware/c6/*/.pio. Artifact hashes and unchanged-sketch checks recorded before removal.
